dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast light-colored perimeters with irregular, slightly serrated outer edges. The gradient transitions sharply from high-intensity white/off-white perimeters to low-intensity dark brown or black interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity solid pixel clusters forming the centers of annuli; localized high-intensity solid pixel clusters are visible in the anterior-dorsal region where annuli are less defined and more confluent.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triangular geometric relationship is formed by three prominent annuli centroids in the mid-dorsal region; a secondary linear-quadrilateral arrangement is formed by the spatial distribution of four distinct annuli centroids along the posterior-lateral axis.
